answer.answer: Three finance-sector programmes combine basic banking, life insurance, and accident insurance as follows: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) provides basic banking through Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (BSBDA) and small accounts without minimum balance requirements [E02]. The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) offers life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason, with a premium of ₹436 per annum, available to account holders aged 18-50 years [E01]. The Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides accident insurance covering accidental death and disability with a premium of ₹20 per annum, available to account holders aged 18-70 years [E03]. Together, these three schemes integrate banking access, life insurance protection, and accident insurance coverage for eligible individuals through their bank and post office accounts.
